newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean blue chips soar on foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: Chilean blue chips soar on foreign buying.

text.p: Chile's selective stock index was up more than two percent on strong buying from overseas, brokers said.
The IPSA index of the 40 most-traded shares was up 2.4 percent to 135.29 points in heavy volume, while the general IGPA was up 1.26 percent to 5776.45 points.
Electrical shares led the way, with Enersis up four percent to 303 pesos, and Endesa up 3.45 percent to 319 pesos.
